messages:
Alex M: Observed a sharp latency spike on shared-pool p-12 starting ~11:22 UTC. 95p generation latency went from ~120ms to ~380ms across several tenants.
Priya S: :eyes: any correlating deploys or kernel changes around that time?
Marco L: I see an autotuner job completed at 11:20 that flipped the default kernel for conv-attn to `fp16_fused_memcopy_v2` on p-12 nodes.
Alex M: That kernel has a larger scratch allocation and falls back to a memcpy path for >2048 seq lengths. A few tenants hit that path repeatedly.
Dana R: We're also seeing a storm of kv-cache evictions logged for tenant team-aurora at 11:21.
infra-bot: [alert] node=pool-p12-gpu03 kv_cache_evictions=827 tenant=team-aurora window=60s
Marco L: Profiling snippet from gpu03 around 11:22 (nvprof-like):
```
GPU 0: kernel_launch conv_attn fp16_fused_memcopy_v2 time=12.34ms cpu_wait=9.2ms memcpy_htod=3.1ms
L2_read_bandwidth=410GB/s L2_write=395GB/s
kv_cache_evict: 1.2k/s
```
Alex M: Looks like memory bandwidth got saturated -> long tail on kernel + repeated KV invalidations. Evicted prefixes then re-requested -> amplification.
Priya S: Which tenant caused the kernel selection? autotuner applies cohort-wide changes. Could be one noisy tenant causing the new default to look better in aggregate.
Dana R: team-aurora had several long-seq batch jobs at the same time. They likely exercised the memcpy fallback.
Marco L: Proposed quick mitigation: revert the autotuner flip for pool p-12 and enable a conservative kernel cap for tenants with >500 qps.
Alex M: Agreed. Also add a guard so that kernel selection prefers memory-local kernels for shared pools if mem_pressure > 70%.
Priya S: I'll open a canary rollback: patch 2026.3.11-revert-kernel and deploy to p-12 staging then prod. Monitoring watch: 95p latency, kv_evictions, GPU mem bw.
ops-bot: deploy started patch=2026.3.11-revert-kernel target=pool-p12-staging
Marco L: For medium-term: change autotuner scoring to include kv-cache eviction rate and per-tenant fairness metric. Current reward function just weighed average latency.
Dana R: Also adjust batching heuristic: reduce max_batch_size for tenants that frequently trigger memcpy fallback, prefer more but smaller batches to avoid long single-kernel runs.
Alex M: I created a perf dashboard panel: `pool-p12 kernel_tail_breakdown` and a log filter for `kv_cache_evict` by tenant.
Priya S: After rollback to previous kernel (fp16_block_fused) on prod p-12 at 11:45, monitoring shows 95p down to ~150ms and kv_evictions dropped 90% for team-aurora. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: [info] deploy completed target=pool-p12-prod patch=2026.3.11-revert-kernel
Marco L: Follow-ups: 1) update autotuner to penalize memory-copy fallbacks 2) add per-tenant kernel cap and throttling 3) run replay test with long-seq templates to avoid regressing again.
Dana R: I'll file a small RFC for per-tenant kernel caps and an experiment plan for replay harness. assigning to Marco + Priya.
Alex M: Thanks all. I'll keep the dashboard in watch for 24h and create an alert if kv_evictions rise >100/min for any tenant.
Priya S: Nice incident response. Recommend adding a postmortem note about the autotuner not considering KV cache churn.
Marco L: Will write short postmortem and include perf traces and the nvprof snippets. expected ETA EOD.
Alex M: Closing here for now. If anyone sees anomalies ping me directly. :wave:
